title: 目的与结果状语从句

examples.en: He got up early so that he could catch the first bus.
examples.zh: 他起得很早，为的是赶上头班车。

examples.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep at once.

guess.question: so that 和 so … that 有什么不一样？

options.text: so that 表目的（为了……）；so + 形容词 + that 表结果（如此……以至于）
options.feedback: 对！看意思：一个是“为了做到”，一个是“结果是”。

options.text: 意思完全一样，只是写法不同
options.feedback: 不对——一个说目的，一个说结果，完全不同。
不对——结构也不同：so that 连在一起，so…that 中间要夹形容词。

rule.rule: so that / in order that 引导目的状语从句（从句常含 can / could / will / would）；so + 形容词或副词 + that、such + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that 引导结果状语从句
rule.formula: ① 目的：so that + 从句（常含 can / could）　② 结果：so + 形容词 / 副词 + that　③ 结果：such + (a / an) + 形容词 + 名词 + that　④ 区别：so 后接形容词副词，such 后接名词

anchors.en: He worked hard so that he could pass the exam.
anchors.zh: 他努力学习，为的是能通过考试。

anchors.en: It was such a difficult question that nobody could answer it.
anchors.zh: 这个问题太难，没人能回答。

trap.wrong: He was so a tired boy that he fell asleep soon.
trap.right: He was such a tired boy that he fell asleep soon.
trap.why: 后面是名词短语 a tired boy，要用 such，不用 so。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——so that 表“为了”，so/such…that 表“结果是”；so 接形容词，such 接名词。

check.stem: He got up very early ____ he could catch the first bus.

options.distractor: so 单独用不引导从句
in order to 后面接动词原形，不接句子

check.explanation: 表目的 → so that（后面接句子）。

check.stem: The box was ____ heavy ____ I couldn't carry it.

options.distractor: too 要搭配 to，不接 that
very 不接 that 从句

check.explanation: so + 形容词 heavy + that（结果）。

check.stem: It was ____ an interesting film ____ I watched it twice.

options.distractor: 后面是名词 an interesting film，要用 such
so…as 用于比较，不表结果
